davellm_edit.COUNT_MISMATCH: old_text was found {found} times, not the expected {expected}; nothing was written
davellm_edit.EDIT_FAILED: The edit could not be written
davellm_edit.EDIT_UNSUPPORTED: Editing files is not supported on this platform
davellm_edit.FILE_CHANGED: The file changed while the edit was being prepared; nothing was written
davellm_edit.MULTIPLE_LINKS: File has more than one hard link
davellm_edit.NO_CHANGE: old_text and new_text are the same
davellm_edit.OVERLAPPING: old_text was found {found} times, but the occurrences overlap, so they cannot all be replaced; nothing was written
davellm_edit.TEXT_NOT_FOUND: old_text was not found in the file; nothing was written

davellm_files.AMBIGUOUS_RELATIVE_PATH: Use an absolute path when several tool roots are configured
davellm_files.MULTILINE_QUERY: Query must be a single line
davellm_files.NOT_A_FILE_OR_DIRECTORY: Path is not a file or directory
davellm_files.NOT_A_REGULAR_FILE: Path is not a regular file
davellm_files.PATH_NOT_ALLOWED: Access denied: path is not allowed

davellm_git.FILE_NOT_AT_REVISION: File not found at that revision
davellm_git.GIT_UNAVAILABLE: Git 2.32 or newer is not available
davellm_git.INVALID_FILE: Use a file path relative to the repository
davellm_git.MODE_CONFLICT: Use staged or revisions, not both
davellm_git.NOT_A_FILE_AT_REVISION: Path is not a file at that revision
davellm_git.UNTRUSTED_REPOSITORY: Repository is owned by another user

davellm_native_tools.BRAIN_UNAVAILABLE: The BRAIN revision captured for this run is not available
davellm_native_tools.PROJECT_RUN_REQUIRED: This tool requires a project-scoped run
davellm_native_tools.PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE: The project for this run is not available
davellm_native_tools.RUN_REQUIRED: This tool requires a DaveLLM run

davellm_notion.BAD_PAGES: DAVE_NOTION_PAGES is not a JSON object of page names to Notion page IDs
davellm_notion.BAD_TOKEN: DAVE_NOTION_TOKEN is not a valid Notion secret
davellm_notion.BLOCK_TEXT_MISMATCH: block_text does not match block {ref}; read the page again
davellm_notion.BLOCK_TEXT_REQUIRED: block_text is required when only checked changes: copy the to-do's text from notion.page.read
davellm_notion.CROSSES_RUNS: old_text in block {ref} crosses a formatting change, a link, a mention, or an equation; edit text inside one run so its formatting is kept
davellm_notion.LEDGER_FULL: This run has read too many Notion blocks; start a new run
davellm_notion.NEEDS_BOTH_TEXTS: old_text and new_text must be given together
davellm_notion.NOTHING_TO_CHANGE: Give old_text and new_text, or checked, or both
davellm_notion.NOT_IN_RUN: Notion tools work only inside a tool run started from DaveLLM
davellm_notion.NOT_REWRITABLE: Block {ref} contains {what} that cannot be written back, so its text cannot be edited
davellm_notion.NOT_TEXT_BLOCK: Block {ref} is a {kind} block; only text blocks can be edited
davellm_notion.NOT_TO_DO: Block {ref} is a {kind} block; only to-do blocks can be checked or unchecked
davellm_notion.NO_PAGES: No Notion pages are configured on this router (DAVE_NOTION_PAGES is unset)
davellm_notion.NO_TOKEN: Notion is not configured on this router (DAVE_NOTION_TOKEN is unset)
davellm_notion.OLD_TEXT_NOT_FOUND: old_text was not found in block {ref}
davellm_notion.OLD_TEXT_REPEATED: old_text occurs {count} times in block {ref}; include more surrounding text so it occurs once
davellm_notion.PAGE_BUSY: Another write to this Notion page is still in progress after waiting; try again when it has finished
davellm_notion.REPEAT_IN_FLIGHT: An earlier append of these exact blocks to '{page}' in this run is still being written or checked, so it is not repeated. Read the page in a moment to see whether it arrived.
davellm_notion.REPEAT_REFUSED: An earlier append of these exact blocks to '{page}' in this run has an unknown outcome, so it is not repeated. Read the page to check whether it arrived, and ask the user before trying again.
davellm_notion.REPEAT_UNDELIVERED: An earlier append of these exact blocks to '{page}' in this run was verified on the page after the run stopped waiting for it, so it is not repeated.
davellm_notion.SAME_TEXT: old_text and new_text are the same
davellm_notion.TOO_LARGE: Notion's response was larger than the 2 MB limit
davellm_notion.TOO_MANY_RUNS: Block {ref} would need more than 100 rich text runs
davellm_notion.UNKNOWN_REF: Unknown block ref {ref}; refs come from notion.page.read in this run

DAVE_ENABLE_EXTENDED_TOOLS.description: Registers the extended tools: bounded reads, web.search and web.read, plus file.edit, which needs approval for every call. Honored only with DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS.

DAVE_ENABLE_NOTION_TOOLS.description: Registers notion.page.read, plus notion.page.append and notion.block.update, which need approval for every call and verify each write. Needs DAVE_NOTION_TOKEN and DAVE_NOTION_PAGES at call time. Honored only with DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS.

DAVE_ENABLE_SHELL_TOOL.description: Registers shell.exec. Execution still needs DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS.

DAVE_ENABLE_TOOLS.description: Turns on tool execution and the core tools.

DAVE_TOOL_ROOTS.description: JSON array of absolute folders that file and Git tools may use.

chat.search.description: Search your own earlier DaveLLM conversations and return short matching snippets.

cluster.status.description: Show which configured DaveLLM nodes are reachable and which models they are known to serve.

file.append.description: Append UTF-8 text inside an allowed tool root.

file.edit.description: Replace exact text in an existing UTF-8 text file inside an allowed tool root. old_text must occur exactly expected_count times (default 1), or nothing is written. Needs the user's approval, which shows the text before and after.

expected_count.description: How many times old_text occurs; any other count refuses the edit.

new_text.description: The replacement text; empty deletes old_text.

old_text.description: The exact text to replace, copied from the file.

path.description: Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it.

file.list.description: List files and folders inside an allowed tool root, sorted by name, with paging. Paths are shown relative to the tool root.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same request.

depth.description: 0 describes the path itself; 1 lists its direct children.

path.description: Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it.

file.read.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside an allowed tool root.

file.read_lines.description: Read up to 400 numbered lines from a UTF-8 text file inside an allowed tool root. Lines start at 1; use next_start_line to continue.

path.description: Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it.

file.search.description: Find lines containing literal text in UTF-8 files inside an allowed tool root. Binary files and files over 1 MiB are skipped.

path.description: Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it.

file.write.description: Write UTF-8 text inside an allowed tool root.

git.diff.description: Show a unified diff for a Git working tree inside an allowed tool root: working-tree changes by default, staged changes with staged=true, or the changes between from_revision and to_revision (default HEAD). Read only.

from_revision.description: A branch, tag, commit hash, or HEAD, optionally followed by ~N or ^N.

path.description: A Git working tree folder, relative to the tool root or absolute inside it.

to_revision.description: A branch, tag, commit hash, or HEAD, optionally followed by ~N or ^N.

git.log.description: List up to 50 recent commits of a Git working tree inside an allowed tool root, newest first, with short hash, date, author, and subject. Read only.

file.description: A file path relative to the repository.

path.description: A Git working tree folder, relative to the tool root or absolute inside it.

git.show.description: Show one commit of a Git working tree inside an allowed tool root, with its message and patch, or one file's text at that commit when file is given. Read only.

file.description: A file path relative to the repository.

path.description: A Git working tree folder, relative to the tool root or absolute inside it.

revision.description: A branch, tag, commit hash, or HEAD, optionally followed by ~N or ^N.

git.status.description: Show the branch, ahead/behind counts, and staged, unstaged, untracked, and conflicted files of a Git working tree inside an allowed tool root. Read only.

path.description: A Git working tree folder, relative to the tool root or absolute inside it.

md.outline.description: List the headings of a Markdown file inside an allowed tool root, in order, with their levels and line numbers. Headings inside code fences are ignored.

path.description: Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it.

md.section.description: Read the lines under one heading of a Markdown file inside an allowed tool root, up to 400 lines. The heading must match exactly, ignoring case; use next_start_line with file.read_lines to continue a long section.

heading.description: The heading text, without the leading # marks.

include_subsections.description: false stops at the first subheading.

path.description: Relative to the tool root, or absolute inside it.

notion.block.update.description: Change one block that notion.page.read returned in this run: replace old_text with new_text inside it, and/or check or uncheck a to-do. old_text must occur once and stay inside one formatting run, so the block keeps its formatting. To check or uncheck a to-do, also give block_text, the to-do's text. Nothing is sent if the block changed or moved since it was read. Needs the user's approval, which shows the text before and after or the to-do.

block.description: A block ref from notion.page.read in this run, such as b3.

block_text.description: The block's whole text as notion.page.read showed it; required when only checked changes.

checked.description: For a to-do: true checks it, false unchecks it.

new_text.description: The replacement text; empty deletes old_text.

old_text.description: The exact text to replace, copied from the block.

page.description: The configured name of the Notion page, such as adapter-test; an unknown name lists the configured ones.

notion.page.append.description: Add plain-text blocks to the end of a configured Notion page: paragraphs, headings, list items, quotes, or to-dos. The result says whether the blocks were verified on the page. Needs the user's approval, which shows the page and every block.

blocks.description: 1 to 50 blocks, added in this order.

checked.description: Only for to_do blocks; default false.

page.description: The configured name of the Notion page, such as adapter-test; an unknown name lists the configured ones.

notion.page.read.description: Read a Notion page the operator configured for DaveLLM, by its configured name. Returns the title and the blocks in order, each with a ref such as b3 that notion.block.update uses in this run. Text is plain; blocks marked formatted keep their formatting when edited.

page.description: The configured name of the Notion page, such as adapter-test; an unknown name lists the configured ones.

project.artifacts.description: List the saved artifacts of the project this run belongs to, or read one artifact's text by passing its identifier as artifact.

artifact.description: An artifact identifier from the list; omit it to list.

project.brain.read.description: Read the BRAIN (pinned, active, and recent project memory) of the project this run belongs to, as it was when the run started.

project.notepad.read.description: Read the plain-text notepad of the project this run belongs to.

shell.exec.description: Execute one command from the fixed safe-command allowlist.

system.info.description: Read bounded operating system and Python runtime information.

web.fetch.description: Fetch a bounded public HTTP or HTTPS text response.

web.read.description: Read a public web page as plain text, with scripts, styles and markup removed; for example a web.search result. Private and local addresses are refused.

web.search.description: Search the web through this router's private search service and return the top results as title, URL and snippet. Open a result with web.read.
